newsitem.title: USA: Cache November same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Cache November same store sales up.

text.p: Cache Inc, a specialty chain of 161 women's apparel stores, said Monday same store sales for the four weeks ended November 23 were up seven percent froma yera ago.
Total sales for the four weeks were $11.0 million, up 10 percent.
November 1995 sales include sales recorded on the Friday and Saturday following Thanksgiving.
Comparable sales for the Friday and Saturday after Thanksgiving this year will be recorded in December sales.
The increase in November 1996 comparable store sales was primarily due to strong sales of regular priced goods, Cache said.
Total sales for the 11 months ended November 23 were $110.6 million, up seven percent from $103.5 million for the same period in 1995.
Same store sales for the 11 month period in 1996 decreased one percent from 1995.
